name: AirForm
tagline: Steel hard-shell monoplace chamber, 1.5 to 2.0 ATA.
description: The OneBase AirForm is the clinic-grade chamber. A robust steel shell delivers 1.5, 1.6 or 2.0 ATA with noiseless pressure-relief valves, an integrated air conditioner, a slide door that seals itself under pressure, and a two-way intercom so staff and client stay connected.

sizes.label: Mini
sizes.note: Narrower one-person chamber for smaller rooms. 75 cm wide.

sizes.label: Plus
sizes.note: Spacious monoplace chamber for the premium experience. 90 cm wide.

highlights.title: Clinic pressures
highlights.body: Operating pressures of 1.5, 1.6 or 2.0 ATA for precise, customised treatments, with specialised equipment rated for higher pressure.

highlights.title: Comfortable, not claustrophobic
highlights.body: Seamless slide-door entry that auto-seals under pressure, a wide viewing window, integrated reading light and climate control inside the chamber.

highlights.title: Always in contact
highlights.body: Two-way intercom phone system and automatic air-pressure control keep sessions safe and simple to run.

highlights.title: One integrated control unit
highlights.body: Compressor, oxygen concentrator and dehumidifier/cooler in a single housing, delivering purified oxygen via mask or nasal cannula.

faqs.q: Are all hyperbaric chambers the same?
faqs.a: No. The main differences are pressure, size and construction material. Soft-shell chambers typically run 1.3–1.5 ATA; hard-shell chambers such as the AirForm reach 2.0 ATA.

faqs.q: How often should I do HBOT?
faqs.a: Most clients see the best results on a protocol of five sessions per week. The OneBase app guides frequency and duration for your goal.
